title: FindingDraftOutput
description: Structured output for the LLM's finding-drafting step. The evidence_level enum is deliberately restricted to E0/E1 only at the schema level, this is the concrete enforcement of 'the LLM cannot silently convert E0/E1 evidence into E2/E3/E4', it is not just a rule stated in a prompt.

evidence_level.description: HARD CAP. This field structurally cannot express E2 or above. A finding needing higher evidence is drafted at E1 and left for a Reviewer to upgrade after an actual test, never drafted as already validated.

framework_reference_code.description: e.g. 'ASI03' or an ACSC ISM guideline code. Must come from the seeded FrameworkReference table, the model does not invent codes.

authority_map_ref.description: Exactly one of node_id or edge_id, this finding must trace to something in the Authority Map, per the traceability invariant.

basis.description: Required justification citing the specific intake material this finding is drawn from. A finding without a basis is rejected before it reaches the database.

self_assessed_certainty_note.description: Optional, free text. NOT a claim the finding is correct, just the model's own hedge for the reviewer's benefit.

contradictions.description: Explicit contradictions found in source material. NOT resolved — surfaces for human reviewer.

unknowns.description: Things the LLM could not determine from source material. Explicitly preserves uncertainty.
